text: The source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest is the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National forest cartography dataset, version 2021. This dataset, also known as MGAP forest map 2021, identified 13.1 hectares of the 13.5-hectare loss area as native forest. The remaining 0.4 hectares were outside mapped forest, and there were no planted forests in the area.
